about: What 37 reference collections (ZIM archives) answered to the household questions of queries.json, as kiwix-serve gave it: titles, article paths and the start of each snippet, in kiwix-serve order, with each collection's description, category, tags and language as its Outpost lists them. Recorded 23 November 2026 from a real library, its full text and its title search (scripts/search-eval/record-reference.mjs). Texts are short quotations of the archives (Stack Exchange and Wikimedia projects, CC BY-SA; others under their own open licences), used to test ranking.
